summary: Re-priced on Campspot for 2027: W+E back-in $40, creek and pull-through $45, full hookup $50 now but $60 from January 2027 - stored 40-60 confirmed; the operator's rv-sites page posts $40/45/50. 30 sites (29 hookup + 1 primitive that doesn't take motorhomes), 50 ft max, pull-through; hookups, showers/laundry/Wi-Fi now operator-sourced; year-round (bookable Jan 2027); booking url + cancellation note. Long-stay: every RV type is sold nightly with plenty free on Saturdays; the site says only that full-hookup sites make 'extended stays' comfortable - no monthly rates or extended-stay area posted any more. Passes. Note unchanged (already clean). See flags.
flags: Phone: the operator's pages mark 678-447-6021 as 'OLD #' and give 'NEW # 678-300-7576' (Campspot also lists 678-300-7576) - update the phone field.
Price: the 6 Full Hookup sites are $60 from January 2027 (over $50; no gateway within 40 km). The W+E types ($40-45) are under the gate, so the entry passes on its cheapest RV site.

Waterfront lead (stored not waterfront): 8 'Water + Electric Creek' sites tagged 'Creek View' ('Our site sat right beside the creek'), and sites ring a small fishing pond (~25 m across on imagery). The creek runs under canopy along the loop's south-west edge; worth a gate check for the creek sites.
The site's note says Google Maps routes to the back entrance; the main entrance/office is under the drive-under sign on US-11 (7643 US-11). Pin is 25 m from Campspot's point - fine.
